title: Global unsafe VFIO mode never substitutes for per-device DMA provider proof
blocker: The repository has E3 QEMU/Guest/VFIO provider-node evidence but no Qman authoritative attach provider that consumes IOMMUFD or TYPE1/TYPE1v2 facts and rejects noiommu devices.
assertions: host global unsafe mode does not by itself make the target ineligible
a target backed by /dev/vfio/noiommu-N is rejected
an IOMMU-backed group/cdev is independently proven at attach time
